title: The 1954 London Palladium exchange with Ted Heath
summary: The Palladium initially refused Lee's trio members, leading to a reciprocal exchange in which Ted Heath's band toured the States.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: the reciprocal thing came about. They argued it out and argued it out, and so if they would allow us to play, then the States was supposed to take Ted Heath, the next year, right?
So you were the first group that got to have the whole band play?

Yes ... yeah. So we were -- this was in '54, and then after we came over, I think the next group was Stan Kenton, and they started exchanging, but Ted Heath even traveled with us, with June Christie and the comedian that married Lucille Ball -- that was the comic with us --
